source_text: 저 여기 주방장님 오시기 전까지 제가 여기 주방장이었어요.
baseline_translation: Before the chef came here, I was the chef here.
emotion_aware_translation: I was the head chef here until the head chef arrived.

baseline_translation: I said let's go to the hospital quickly.
emotion_aware_translation: I said let's go to the hospital now!

source_text: 윤찬 대리 이제 제가 해드릴 건 없네요.
baseline_translation: Deputy Manager Yoonchan, there's nothing more I can do for you now.
emotion_aware_translation: Assistant Manager Yoonchan, there's nothing left for me to do for you now.

source_text: 미안해 사실 이번에도 월급을 못 받았어.
baseline_translation: I'm sorry, but the truth is I didn't get paid this time either.
emotion_aware_translation: I'm sorry, but the truth is I didn't get paid this time either.

baseline_translation: Why were you so worried about me?
